invariants.rationale: The profile parameter is used throughout the method and must be non-null to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
The context parameter is utilized to fetch small files for partitions, requiring it to be non-null.
Partition paths are accessed from profile at the start of the method and are critical for partition logic.
The output partition path stats map is read and potentially updated for each partition, so it needs to exist.
The method checks profile.hasOutputWorkLoadStats() before updating output stats; this ensures the method is callable and safe, and that the field is valid for logic.
